title: Encoding a nonempty child list
statement: For any natural number $n$, any Boolean circuit tree $d$ on $n$ variables, and any list $D$ of such trees, the encoding of the child list beginning with $d$ is the bit $1$, followed by the encoding of $d$, followed by the encoding of $D$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a circuit tree on $n$ variables
$D$ is a list of circuit trees on $n$ variables
